regionLinks

Source: R/annotateRegions.R, R/resultsMethods.R
regionLinks.Rd

Returns the region-to-gene links stored in an object by annotateRegions, one row per link. Also sets them, which is how a contact table computed elsewhere is attached to an object that never went through a TxDb.

Usage

regionLinks(object)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
regionLinks(object)

regionLinks(object) <- value

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.provenance'
regionLinks(object) <- value

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.geneResults'
regionLinks(object)

Arguments

object

RegionSetDE.counts, RegionSetDE.fit, RegionSetDE.results or RegionSetDE.setResults object. Not a RegionSetDE object: the links live beside the counted rows, so the regions have to be counted first.

value

Data.frame or GRanges with the links, for the replacement form.

Value

A data.frame with the columns region and gene.id, together with whatever else the links carried: gene.symbol, distance.to.tss, link.weight, weight.source and link.type. NULL when the object has not been annotated.

Details

A region linked to no gene is kept in the table with a missing gene.id, which is how an unassigned region stays distinguishable from a region nothing was computed for. Count the genes with na.omit rather than on the rows.

The replacement form runs the same checks annotateRegions does and refuses a table that would be ambiguous, so attaching links by hand is as safe as building them.

See also

annotateRegions, geneSetsToRegionSets

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

counts <- loadExampleData("counts", verbose = FALSE)

regionTable <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowRanges(counts))[1:4, 1:3]
regionLinks(counts) <- data.frame(regionTable, gene.id = c("11287", "66968", "73824", "20683"))

regionLinks(counts)
#>                                        region gene.id
#> promoterNonCpG|region_00002   chr12:4041-5040   11287
#> promoterNonCpG|region_00003   chr12:6212-7211   66968
#> promoterNonCpG|region_00005 chr12:10685-11684   73824
#> promoterNonCpG|region_00006 chr12:13540-14539   20683
